articleTitle: Smart and Digitalized Traffic Rules Montioring System
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Road way forms are one of the most commonly used modes of transports. It is very important to follow and monitor the Traffic rules to control the flow of traffic and to avoid road accidents. According to a survey, In India, more than 150,000 people are killed each year in traffic accidents. That’s about 400 fatalities a day and far higher than in other countries. Government must take effective measures to control the road accidents. One of the main reasons for accidents is improper monitoring of traffic. In this project, we have come up with traffic rules monitoring system which helps in faster and easier monitoring. This system is very useful in countries like India due to its population. Traffic police gets right to halt any vehicle, if any cause and check the documents manually. It is very hard for a citizen to carry all his documents every time. In the given proposed system, all the process is automated and a proper database can be maintained to track the driver records regarding traffic rule violation. It also helps in detection of the unlicensed drivers, drunken drivers and allows fingerprint payment. In case of heavy traffic roads, the license plate number of those vehicles crossing the rules is detected automatically and later the penalty is collected from the automobile owner. A message is also sent to the driver from database including details about the number times he/she violated traffic rules so far and the penalty amount. This system may be further developed for toll payments for highway traffic.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Ecofriendly vehicle and its Impact on Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Wheel has been one of the greatest inventions in human civilization. It's said that life run on wheels as today automobiles are an important part in running the world. As technology has advanced the two wheelers and four wheelers have become an easy mode of transportation for every household. Due to this, fuel consumption has increased beyond its limit usage and we are facing a situation where we have to think about the sustainability of our future generation. These wheels need to run on energy source other than the conventional fuels. Solar energy is greater source of non-renewable energy. We can harness the solar energy to run the vehicles. In this paper our main objective is to create a prototype of a solar based vehicle which is a tricycle. The solar vehicle can be a cost effective and environment friendly solution for daily usage of mode of transportation. The prototype consists of a charge controller, solar panel, DC hub motor and battery.

articleTitle: Multi Rectangular Slotted Hexa Band Micro-strip Patch Antenna for Multiple Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A multi rectangular slotted antenna is analyzed and simulated by FEKO simulation software. Two rows of rectangular slots are introduced in the rectangular geometry enhance radiation. Many feeding technique are available out of them Micro-strip feed technique is used for this design. Hexa stands for six resonant frequencies generated by this design. Due to concept of fractal antenna similar slots are introduced in rectangle increases the current length and discontinuity. This design is useful for six band applications. The value of return loss is less than -10 dB in all six bands with acceptable bandwidth. Frequencies of resonance are 0.27GHz, 1.7GHz, 3.3GHz, 2.7GHz, 3.5GHz and 4.3GHz their respective return loss are -53dB, -31dB, -36dB, -16dB, -31dB and -25dB. Dimensions of antenna are 40mm*50mm due to this size of antenna is small which makes it portable. The values of VSWR are close to two for respective frequencies which is useful for operating frequency range. FR4 substrate is used for the design and analysis for this antenna with dielectric 4.4 and thickness of 1.3 mm. The design is analyzed by FEKO software based on Method of Moment.

articleTitle: Design of meander line antenna for wearable applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Meander line antenna (MLA) is electrically small antenna which have been designed to operate at 2.45 GHz for WLAN application which is a wearable antenna. This paper briefly describes the design of meander line antenna structure using jeans as substrate which has a dielectric constant of 1.6 and thickness of 3.6 mm. Here, Microwave studio CST is used for simulation process. As MLA requires only a less space, it is widely used in most of the applications. This antenna is proposed to achieve more bandwidth and reduction in size. Here the return loss and VSWR of the antenna has been described.

articleTitle: A brief introduction to High Availability Seamless Redundancy (HSR) and some of its drawbacks : An insight into the functioning of HSR Protocol
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: High-availability Seamless Redundancy (HSR) is a standard (IEC 62439-3 Clause 5 [1]) which answers to the need for reliable Ethernet. It is suitable for real time applications. This paper describes the working principle of HSR along with some of its drawbacks. Zero recovery time can be achieved in case of a single failure with the help of HSR. Basically HSR works in a ring topology and it can further be extended to many other topologies particularly rings of rings.HSR was originally proposed for use in automation of smart grid electrical substation[9]. Industrial automation, motion control and transportation are some other areas where it can be implemented.

articleTitle: Quantitative Feedback Theory based Robust Controller Design for Speed Control of DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: DC motor speed control is critical assignment in turning machines, Fans, Blowers, Conveyors, Centrifugal Pumps, Lifts, Weaving Machine based continuous applications. In this proposed original copy different strong controller configuration has been actualized to control the speed and position of settled field DC motor at different unfaltering state speed and position, which gives speedier settling time, least pinnacle overshoot, least ascent time and low relentless state mistake while its dynamic transient change concerning load characteristics. articleTitle: Hessian LLE and Naïve Bayesian Classifier for Epilepsy Classification from EEG Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The detection and classification of Electroencephalography (EEG) signals is quite an important issue in the field of biomedical research for analysis, evaluation and diagnosis procedures of various neurological problems. Detecting and classifying epileptic seizure from EEG signals efficiently is beneficial for managing a lot of neurological abnormalities. For a wide range of applications in the biomedical community, evaluating the physiological state of the brain is quite important and that can be done with the aid of EEG signals. To study about the functions of the brain and to indicate the electrical activities of the brain, EEG is used widely. As the recordings of the epileptic EEG signals are quite long, processing it is very difficult and so dimensionality reduction has to be preferred.

articleTitle: Critical Analysis of Performance Optimization of Mobile Web Services in Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In today`s world of science & technology mobile device especially Smartphones plays the role of “"Jinn" who fulfill demand of the user. Smartphone through its Internet facility allows users to access various internet based web services ubiquitously to fulfill his/her demand. Web Services can be of two types SOAP or Restful services. Many researchers have mentioned that SOAP based services are heavy to consume on mobile device despite the fact that most of the companies still uses SOAP services but answer to this challenge is Restful Web Services. Restful services also surfers from many problems like processing of work or accessing services on device due to mobile phone`s small screen size, low processing power, less memory storage capacity etc. That`s why the heavy processing work is shifted on Cloud and only client part will be on mobile device, this integration is called as Mobile Cloud Computing (MCC). In MCC important point need to consider is to improve the performance of web services in terms of speed, memory usage and reducing latency. To resolve these issues, this paper has proposed MCC architecture. We have divided this paper is into two parts, in the first part; we did comparative analysis of Web Service consumption on mobile devices using cloud and various parameters used. In second part we have proposed architecture for mobile Web Services in Cloud which compress response data using Gzip and use of web caching to reduce overhead of repeated or previously accessed Web Service.

articleTitle: Digital Image Watermarking based on Successive Division
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this paper, successive division and concatenation based image watermarking scheme has been proposed. Successive division reduces the pixel intensity of watermark image in order to embed the same into host. Concatenation helps in embedding multiple images of watermark into host. After de-watermarking process, the multiple images of same watermark are filtered and unified to get the desired watermark. The watermarked images are subjected for various security attacks such as noise interference and cropping effects. The retrieved watermark gives high degree of similarity to the original watermark. From the security analysis, better results are obtained for the proposed algorithm compared to other existing techniques.

articleTitle: Refined Steering Procedure for MANETs
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Mobile ad hoc networks (MANETs) was designed for sustaining military applications in 70's but with time span developments and unique advantages of this network it has fetched high interest of research community and became as a hot research topic in present days. However, this network scheme overcome the pitfalls of wired network and provides much efficient connectivity between end points but due to consisting of mobiles nodes and limited power constraints the MANETs faces several challenges. Implementation of an efficient routing protocol for Manet's network is one of the great dare for the related field researchers in present time. Since the age of MANETs several approaches has proposed to overcome routing issues of this network but due to unique structure and distinctiveness till today a single algorithm is not capable to outperform with each scenario of MANETs. To fill this gap this paper suggest a healthier routing scheme based on founding, adjust and safeguarding of an effective route at active time. Additionally proposed approach has give more focus on trim down the nodes overheads. The evaluated results under NS2 evidently specify the supremacy of designed approach over traditional and other accessible methods.

articleTitle: Overview of Optical Flow Technique for Mobile Robot Obstacle Avoidance
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Visual navigation is a recent trend to navigate robot. This paper presents the utilization of optical flow technique to achieve this with robust results. It helps in detecting the relativistic relation and related movement of the object. An important task for this is, to detect the obstacles and execute navigation without colliding with an obstacle when the robot is moving. Optical flow is calculated from the sequence of images in the video grabbed by the camera raised on the robot. From this, we further calculate the focus of expansion (FOE). This helps to find the time to contact (TTC). This calculation will provide information about an obstacle in the path, depth and the time needed to collide with the obstacle. By this information, the robot can navigate autonomously without the interference of human, since this all is done onboard. For implementing this, we will use coarse to fine warping method. An experiment will be performed under various environment settings, which will show fewer errors than the earlier implementation for mobile robot and increased performance under noise.

articleTitle: Determination of Impedance Mismatch in Transmission Line using Developed TDR
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A Time Domain Reflectometer (TDR) with rise time of 5ns is developed using a Digital Storage Oscilloscope (DSO) of 200MHz having data storing capacity of 2000 data points for a single waveform. This TDR is used to calculate the Velocity of Propagation (VOP) in a transmission line and if any impedance mismatches due to addition of any other transmission line. The proposed paper explains the system accuracy by calculating the VOP of different transmission lines and the distance of impedance mismatch from the place where the new transmission line is added.

articleTitle: A brief review of wireless sensors used for acquiring ECG
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: With the fast moving trends in technology every single day, it is hard to keep up with it. The drawback of this trend is that not everyone can access it. Heart diseases are considered as one of the world’s leading cause of death. The heart patients have to follow various tests for diagnosis and treatment. The existing technique, i.e., the most commonly used technique, ECG is expensive and invasive. It can be applied only under clinical observation. To overcome the limitations of existing invasive systems of heart rate measurement, the non-invasive wireless techniques are required. A fully functioning ECG and probes is very scarce in the rural areas. The limitation of cardiovascular services in rural areas is one of the major concerns in India and yet it has not been resolved for long time. The administering of ECG test and interpreting the result requires the doctor to be present on-site and in rural areas it is unrealistic for the doctor to be present all the time. The concept of usage of electrodes that operate without gels, adhesives and skin contact have been known for many decades, they have not been accepted for any medical use. In this paper we will discuss about sensors which can be used as an alternative for the probes i.e. the lead system, and wireless transmission of the signal to mobile, laptop or any other source of display.

articleTitle: Multichannel MAC for Wireless Sensor Network applications
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network is one of the major areas in wireless communications which extend its application in military, security, internet and scientific purposes. For a network which has dynamically varying channel gain and random topology, selection of operating parameters which improves network performance is always a challenging task. Single channel MAC is generally used in statistical analysis, but providing multi channel MAC will improve the performance of the channel. Multichannel is available in 802.11b/g which operates at 3 different non overlapping channels. In this paper we implemented 802.11g multichannel MAC using NS-2.34 and compared the performance of the network with single channel MAC in terms of throughput, packet delivery ratio and throughput. The multichannel uses back off algorithm and switches between the 3 non overlapping channels whenever the contention window of distributed coordination function reaches the maximum threshold value and thus gives better performance.

articleTitle: Development of Brain MRI Image Segmentation Algorithms using Deformable Models
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: A Unique methodology to the segmentation of brain MRI images and detect accurately the brain tumor boundary using deformable models so that doctor can do the surgery or any other medical procedure without ambiguity and to reduce the amount of manual interaction and to Improve computational speed of segmentation. The objective of the work is to improve computational speed of segmentation methods, reduce the amount of manual interaction and increasing precision tolerances and algorithms are validated with bench mark data base. The performances of the proposed algorithms are evaluated with various performance measures.

articleTitle: Information Technology Language Encryption Register (ITLER)
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this paper we’ve proposed a hand-held device that can be connected to your phones that allows the encryption and decryption of text messages. The device that inspired us is called an Enigma machine, which is a polyalphabetic cipher. The Enigma machine is taken as the base of what our model envisions. The deciphering of this encryption system cannot be done that easily even by frequency analysis and other cryptanalysis techniques. These enigma machines were used in the Second World War to send and receive encrypted messages, but those machines were far too bulky and were in the form of a typewriter. We have come up with a much more efficient and simpler way to send encrypted messages in a much smaller scaled device, a TFT screen (3 inches approx.).In simpler terms, the device connects to your smartphone to send and receive encrypted messages, pushing the boundaries of the Enigma machine right into the 21sh century.

articleTitle: Generation of optical delay through chirped fiber bragg grating inscribed in a polymer optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: In this work, we have proposed chirped fiber Bragg grating inscribed in a polymer optical fiber for optical delay generation. The proposed scheme utilizes the best attributes of both chirped Bragg gratings and polymer optical fibers. The delay is generated by utilizing distributed reflectance property of the chirped Bragg gratings. The optical delay depends upon effective refractive index of the core, photo-elastic constant, source incident wavelength and bandwidth and elongation length. The proposed scheme is much efficient than conventional silica fiber.

articleTitle: Big Data Analysis on Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper intends to draw the versions of the given and the transcript form the Big Data over the given form of the supply chain, this demystifies the given and comply the formed and complete system of the given Supply Chain(SCM) and the Big Data towards the completion to produce maximum productivity of the control management and the support production towards the formed from the control of customer and the market relying on the network. articleTitle: Developing an Algorithm for Scene Understanding and Decision Making Based on Visual Perception
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Trending is the era of artificial intelligence, which now a day plays very crucial roles for performing daily repetitive as well as decision making complex tasks. Sensing the dynamic scenario and making decision based on visual perception is blooming a bit. In this we propose an algorithm in which we divide the image in two categories frame of reference and the visual objects. Frame of reference gives a platform on which the object is placed that deals in making environment decision. We use faster RCNN algorithm for object and background detection. In co-relation of object, there motion and environmental condition, for making decisions Naives bayes algorithm is developed which is used to sense the surrounding and automatically make a decision based on visual perception and coordinate needs. At the end we analysis the experimental results such as training accuracy, total losses function which has pretty fine reliability and accuracy.

articleTitle: Regeneration of Electrical Energy From Motors
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Electric current is used to energise equipment in electric power. Throughout the world, conservation of electric energy is mainly focused. articleTitle: Design of Radiation Hardened Inverter using CMOS Process
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: This paper presents design of Radiation Hardened Inverter using CMOS process. The technique which is used to harden the inverter is Radiation Hardened by design which is implemented in this paper. Inverter is designed basically for use in electronic circuits where Radiation environment is present. Proposed V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GS</inf> negative based Inverter is designed in Cadence–Virtuoso Schematic editor and simulated in Cogenda TCAD software suit. In this design particles are incident on active area that is input node of the circuit. Single event upset caused by different particle with different energies are observed on Radiation Hardened Inverter. Analysis of recovery time and output voltage level is measured. A comparison is made between conventional Inverter and Radiation Hardened Inverter and it shows that logic level do not change in Radiation Hardened Inverter

articleTitle: Denoising System for MR Image Using Speckle Degradation Index
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Denoising plays a crucial role in generating a good quality MR image which is necessary for the process of diagnosis. Bilateral filter is the most suitable candidate for medical image denoising for its ability to retain contours of soft tissue structures. The proposed denoising system includes bilateral filter in non-iterative as well as iterative form to achieve efficient performance at all the noise levels. The work here implements a selection mechanism based on speckle degradation index which chooses to apply bilateral filter for low noise while the one in iterative form for noisy MR image. The results indicate that the proposed system outperforms the individual filters for denoising. The paper further suggests a total quality analysis by using edge based Pratt's Figure of Merit (PFOM) metric along with PSNR and mean SSIM. This can be helpful to assess and benchmark the system performance as well as may be helpful in analysing the extent of abnormality in tissue structures. The system is developed using OpenCV as it provides a notable speedup in execution.

articleTitle: Isometric Mapping and Probabilistic Classifier for Epilepsy Classification from EEG Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: One of the most commonly occurring neurological disorders is epilepsy. The main technique used in the diagnosis and analysis of epilepsy is Electroencephalography (EEG) signals. The epileptic EEG signals show the electrical activities of the neurons and comprise a lot of pathological and physiological information. As this technique consumes a lot of time, various automatic classification systems came into existence. In this paper, Isometric Mapping (Isomap) is used as a dimensionality reduction technique to reduce the dimensions of the epileptic EEG signals and then it is classified with the help of the most famous probabilistic classifier, Naïve Bayesian Classifier (NBC). Results show that when Isometric Mapping is used with NBC, an average classification accuracy of 90.02% is obtained along with an average time delay of 2.27 seconds.

articleTitle: Convex - Optimization for Reconstructing Compressed Signal using Orthogonal Matching Pursuit
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Reconstruction of 2D signals is challenging as it involves a large number of samples. To reduce the redundant data, a sparse representation technique called Compressed Sensing (CS) is explored. In compressed sensing, sparse vector is compressed in size by using suitable sensing matrix. However reconstruction of original signal from compressed signal needs better understanding of sparseness of original signal and characteristics of sensing matrix. The reconstruction algorithm belongs to the category of convex optimization. This paper proposes an iterative greedy algorithm used in convex optimization technique for image reconstruction named Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (OMP). This work demonstrates how effectively we can use OMP to recover k-sparse signals in greedy fashion with lesser number of random linear measurements for a signal. The experimental results support the same.

articleTitle: Metaheuristic Algorithms Based Crop Classification
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: The study of agriculture and agricultural production is an important part of planning for allocation of resources and economic forecasting. The prediction of crop output requires collecting accurate crop data through-out the growing season, in locations with a wide range of climatic conditions. To ensure the accurate estimation for forecasting the harvests and crop insurance; the type of crop and area should be regularly measured all through the year. Moreover, crop classification by remote sensing data is becoming more important. With the help of Satellite image time series (SITS) and number of classification approaches there are more chances of efficient crop classification. This proposal intends to rectify some of the issues like crop similarity, salt and pepper noise that obtained in crop classification process.

articleTitle: Optimistic Attack Detection Using Triangular Mutation based Particle Swarm Optimization in Wireless Multimedia Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: To detect the attack, a Novel Triangular mutation based Particle Swarm Optimization with attack detection ADOV technique has been proposed. The Ad Hoc On-Demand Distance Vector (AODV) algorithm is using the connectivity concept to decide between source and local repair when a link break occurs. Besides, we used a Computational Intelligence algorithm, called Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), which enables to find candidate solutions in all considered search space in order to reduce average data packet drop ratio over the network. The performance of the original TIGMR protocol based geographic multipath routing is compared with this new implemented approach, called here as AODV-PSO. Two metrics were used to evaluate the performance of the algorithm: Packet drop ratio and throughput. We observed that the AODV-PSO outperformed the original AODV protocol in the scenarios studied in this paper.

Author Keywords: Triangular Mutation based Particle Swarm optimization (PSO) and AODV routing protocol

articleTitle: A Result Evaluation Based On Privacy Preserving Using Unified Security Methods (PPUSM)
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Cloud computing is defined as a model to access shared computing resources through network in a manner which is ubiquitous, on demand, requires less time for provision and release of resources and requires minimum intervention of management authorities. With such flexibility there arise two problems of data privacy and data security which are open research problem. The first problem of privacy says that how a user's data can be stored such that only authorized persons gets access to it. The problem of security demands the security of data in such a manner that not only on storage but also in between transition of data on network the data will be useless for intruders. In this paper we address both of the problems simultaneously. Specifically, we present a model for privacy and security such that the security is provided by encrypting the data at the owner end and then putting it on the cloud while the privacy is provided by a secured key exchange between the owner and the user. Our model is such that the data remains in the encrypted form throughout the cloud, including network access and hence there is no chance of its misuse.

articleTitle: Legal Files Management System Using Big Data
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Have you ever Wondered how data can be used as a weapon as well as useful information?. The Apche ambari is a Hadoop interface used to manipulate and analyze distributed data across number of clusters. In this survey some major cause for the fire accidents are analyzed and based on what technology they are providing safety measures are also analyzed. Through IOT many of the safety measurements are implemented nowadays. From the survey taken most of the fire detection method detects fire after it is triggered. articleTitle: Road traffic prediction based on base station location data by Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2018 3rd International Conference on Communication and Electronics Systems (ICCES)
abstract: Now road traffic monitoring is very meaningful to the serious road traffic congestion problem all over the world. Operators have a large number of base stations location information (OIDD) which can be used to detect road condition. However, for the reason that base station data have the disadvantage of inaccurate location, fixed location and so on, direct calculating the road evaluation speed is not effective. In this paper, by extracting diverse features from base station data, we propose new method based on machine learning model Random Forest and classification association to predict road condition. We apply our method to real complex roads in some province. Take the existing commercial road app real-time monitoring as the benchmark, the experiments demonstrate that our method performs better than the traditional road prediction algorithms.
